csv_project_name: AE for Vernon Forrest Park Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Augusta is requesting Statement of Qualifications from qualified engineering and/or architectural firms to provide professional design services for Vernon Forrest Park Improvement project for the Recreation and Parks Department. Prepare schematic design plans based on the existing concept plan for review and approval by ARPD. The schematic plans will identify general park layout, grading and drainage, and utilities. Prepare preliminary and final plans that includes: 1. Civil design to include site layout, grading, drainage, site utility plans, and erosion and sedimentation control plans. 2. Geotechnical investigation. 3. Landscaping and green/sustainable design for the park greenspace. 4. Architectural design to include building plans, elevations, and sections. 5. Structural design to include foundations, framing, and structural details. 6. Electrical design includes building lighting, receptacles, and site lighting. 7. Mechanical and plumbing design to include water supply, drainage, and ventilation for any proposed improvements (i.e. restrooms). B. Develop and submit preliminary design and development plans (60% construction plans), and draft technical specifications to ARPD for review and approval. C. Prepare preliminary construction estimates. D. Develop and submit final design and development plans (90% construction plans) and technical specifications for ARPD review. E. Meet with ARPD to review 90% construction documents and discuss review comments. F. Final construction estimate. G. Provide professional opinions of probable construction costs (OPCs) at each phase of design(i.e., 60% and 90% construction plan completion. H. Upon approval from ARPD, 100% final construction documents (plans and technical specifications) for solicitation of construction bids will be prepared. I. Preparations and attendance for public meetings is also required. J. Construction contract administration. K. Construction observation as needed.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Site Evaluation/Selection, Sanitation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Utility Engineering

project_scope: Professional design services for Vernon Forrest Park improvements based on an existing concept plan. Scope includes schematic design, park layout, grading and drainage, utilities, civil site design, erosion and sedimentation control, geotechnical investigation, landscaping and sustainable greenspace design, architectural design for park buildings or restrooms, structural design including foundations and framing, electrical, mechanical and plumbing design, cost estimates, final construction documents, public meetings, construction administration, and construction observation.
services: Engineering and architectural design services from schematic design through final construction documents; civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, landscape architecture, architectural design, structural design, electrical, mechanical and plumbing design, cost estimating, bid documents, construction contract administration, and construction observation.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a park improvement and site development project, not a core sbp focus.
- Includes some structural and architectural design, but likely limited to small ancillary park buildings/restrooms.
- Strong emphasis on civil, landscape, utilities, and multidisciplinary building services rather than complex load-bearing structures.
- No indication of long spans, bridges, roofs, towers, stadiums, or architecturally demanding special structures.
- Contains rehabilitation/refurbishment and general park planning elements, which are generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The documents mention preparation of construction estimates and opinions of probable cost at 60%, 90%, and final stages, indicating costs were not fixed in the notice. Likely components include siteworks, utilities, landscaping, and small park structures/restrooms, but no realistic USD estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No design fee or engineering budget is stated in the source. The scope covers full multidisciplinary design and construction administration over a 12-month base period with possible renewals, but there is insufficient cost information to derive a reliable sbp fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Statement of Qualifications requested from qualified engineering and/or architectural firms. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the source.
